master_astrological_reference.title: Complete Unified Astrological Master Reference – Maximum Detail & Long-Form Synthesis
master_astrological_reference.description: Exhaustive, self-contained consolidation of astrological chart construction, astronomical/astrological calculations, house systems, strength-weighting methods, predictive timing systems, eclipse activation logic, and integrated synthesis workflow into one normalized machine-readable JSON.

source_text.author: Y.K. Bansal
source_text.publisher: Bharatiya Prachya Evam Sanatan Vigyan Sansthan
source_text.purpose: Structured course material for Jyotisha Praveena / NOTISHA PRAVEEN certification of the Indian Council of Astrological Sciences.

sidereal_time.definition: Time measured relative to fixed stars; a sidereal day is approximately 23h 56m 4s.

steps: Take sidereal time at 12h noon LMT for reference year at 82°30'E.
Apply place correction to convert to local reference.
Convert birth civil time to Local Mean Time (LMT).
Compute absolute interval from local noon.
Apply acceleration correction for sidereal gain.
Subtract interval for AM births and add for PM births to get final LST.
lahiri_table_method.example: Delhi, 25 Oct 2002, 09:30 IST => Local Sidereal Time ≈ 11:22:22

ayanamsha.definition: Precessional offset between tropical vernal point and sidereal zero point.
ayanamsha.conversion_rule: nirayana_longitude = sayana_longitude - ayanamsha; add 360° if negative

precession_of_equinoxes.dynamical_cause: Lunisolar torque acting on Earth’s equatorial bulge produces axial precession.

input_requirements: Birth time (clock time + zone + DST status)

pipeline_steps.name: Normalize time
pipeline_steps.details: Convert civil time to UTC, then to LMT if using table-based sidereal workflows.

pipeline_steps.name: Compute sidereal context
pipeline_steps.details: Compute Greenwich sidereal time and local sidereal time or use Lahiri table method.

pipeline_steps.name: Compute angles
pipeline_steps.details: Derive RAMC from LST and compute ASC/MC by spherical trigonometric formulas.

pipeline_steps.name: Compute planetary positions
pipeline_steps.details: Read geocentric longitudes/latitudes/speeds from ephemeris at birth moment.

pipeline_steps.name: Apply zodiac frame
pipeline_steps.details: For sidereal charts subtract ayanamsha from tropical longitudes and normalize 0°-360°.

pipeline_steps.name: Generate houses
pipeline_steps.details: Create cusps with selected house system (Placidus/Koch/Equal/Whole Sign/Sripathi).

pipeline_steps.name: Derive divisional and auxiliary charts
pipeline_steps.details: Compute Varga set (e.g., D9/Navamsha) and optional Jaimini/Arudha structures.

pipeline_steps.name: Compute strengths and yogas
pipeline_steps.details: Run Shadbala, Ashtakavarga, dignities, avasthas, aspects, and condition-specific yogas.

pipeline_steps.name: Compute timing layers
pipeline_steps.details: Compute Vimshottari and/or Yogini periods, transits, progressions, directions, returns.

pipeline_steps.name: Synthesize delineation
pipeline_steps.details: Combine static natal promise + dynamic timing + weighted significance into final narrative.

house_systems.method: Semi-arc method based on MC timing
Entire sign containing ASC degree is House 1

vedic_predictive.name: Jaimini Chara Karakas
vedic_predictive.method: Rank planets by descending longitude (most schools exclude nodes).

western_predictive.name: Secondary progressions
western_predictive.principle: 1 day after birth corresponds to 1 year of life

western_predictive.name: Solar arc directions
western_predictive.principle: Apply same directed arc (usually Sun arc) to all planets/angles

western_predictive.name: Solar return
western_predictive.principle: Annual chart at exact Sun return to natal longitude

western_predictive.name: Annual profections
western_predictive.principle: Advance house lord by one sign per year from natal ascendant

shadbala_framework.output: Per-planet and aggregate weighted strength profile

extended_weight_model.objective: Unify multi-school indicators into a single scalar + vector interpretation model.
extended_weight_model.normalization: All sub-scores normalized to [0,1], weighted sum normalized to 100.
extended_weight_model.confidence_adjustment: Reduce final certainty when conflicting high-magnitude indicators coexist.

conflict_resolution_rules: If dignity is strong but heavily afflicted, reduce net expression strength and increase volatility flag.
If natal promise is weak but timing activation is extreme, classify as temporary surge event.
If multiple independent systems converge (e.g., dasha + transit + progression), boost event probability tier.

natal_core: Karakas and arudhas (if Jaimini layer used)
timing_merge_protocol: Identify baseline life themes from natal chart.
Prioritize windows where at least three methods converge within orb/time tolerance.
Generate narrative with probability tiers: low/moderate/high/critical activation.

rule_notes: Extended orb observations up to 2.5° for Uranus/Neptune
Neptune remained near the 1999 eclipse degree through much of 2000

example_correlates: Broader precursor dynamics later associated with 9/11 planning narratives

validation_rules: Store sign-degree both as absolute and sign-format fields
Record ayanamsha model and value at event time
